prompt: Read the JSON list of Gmail message IDs in /tmp/svb_chunk0.json (mailbox robert@harmonygames.co). For every ID, fetch the message with the mcp__hg__gmail_get_messages_batch tool (user_email "me", format "full", max 10 ids per call; pass the ids exactly as in the file). Large results are saved to files automatically — parse them with python via Bash. To: Leapblock LTD ***1359 Amount: 3,700.00 USD Transaction Date: Feb 02 2026 ... Delivery Date: ...". Write all rows as a JSON list to /tmp/svb_rows0.json. Do NOT skip any id; if one fails, retry it alone. Your final answer: just confirm the file path, the row count, and list any rows whose notification type is not 'Payment Processed' or whose body contains unusual text (quote it). Be read-only: do not send, modify or delete anything.
